title: Daryl Bem's backward causality study and failed replications
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Daryl Bem's backward causality study and failed replications, about 2010-2011 at Cornell University, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: the replication crisis started in 2010 with Daryl Beam's research on the backward causality, that's how it began.

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher and skeptic, said on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2026 that the so-called replication crisis, when many psychology findings could not be repeated, began in 2010 with a study by Daryl Bem at Cornell University. Shermer says Bem's paper claimed to show backward causality, people sensing events before they happen, and others such as Ray Hyman, Richard Wiseman and Stuart Ritchie could not get the same results. He tells it to show how such claims fall apart when tested again.
